title: Commonwealth Register of Institutions and Courses for Overseas Students (CRICOS): providers, courses and locations
lineage: the newest CRICOS workbook on data.gov.au, downloaded by the Fetch institution registries workflow
notes: in scope: CRICOS providers with at least one current bachelor's, master's or doctoral degree course
scope: Australia: every provider registered on CRICOS to teach overseas students at least one current bachelor's, master's or doctoral degree (universities and other higher education providers).
manifest_notes: CRICOS has about 1,550 providers; the rest teach only vocational, English-language or school courses and are out of scope.
